note: Closure criteria for prior D4 findings (r1-r4); statuses and verdicts removed.

findings.title: The host gate accepts a reconciliation made before a new launch

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4GateStaleLedger
closure_check.expected: The new unreserved launch closes the host gate before any transition append.

closure_check.method: Add a review dispatch or loop evidence after a clean scan, then request progression
closure_check.expected: The prior scan is stale. A current clean scan remains a positive control.

findings.title: Any historical approved plan can hide a new generation dependency rewind

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4HistoricalPlanHidesDependencyRevocation
closure_check.expected: The old plan is refused for the new generation, or the generation-bound plan still detects the U2 rewind.

closure_check.method: Reconcile a run containing reservations from two plans, before and after each dependency rewind
closure_check.expected: Both generations use their own dependency graph. Legitimate earlier launches remain authorized.

findings.title: Review dispatch validity ignores rewinds and lease generations

closure_check.method: Run both listed tests
closure_check.expected: Every review at or after the applicable rewind is unauthorized; a launch just before the rewind is authorized.

closure_check.method: Renew a lease and launch the old review ID, then issue a fresh review in the new generation
closure_check.expected: Old dispatch remains revoked. The new dispatch is independently eligible when stage and route rules pass.

findings.title: Review ledgers are neither bound nor included in scan coverage

closure_check.method: Run both listed tests
closure_check.expected: A wrong-namespace review is unauthorized or refused. The separate review ledger is scanned, the rogue becomes BLOCK, and the review gate closes.

closure_check.method: Put implementation and review receipts in one namespace in reversed scan order
closure_check.expected: Both valid launches remain authorized and implementation attempt accounting is unchanged.

findings.title: Rounding valid_from down authorizes pre-issuance launches

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4ExactLowerBound
closure_check.expected: Both earlier timestamps are unauthorized; the exact bound is authorized.

closure_check.method: Launch at valid_until and one timestamp just before it
closure_check.expected: The upper tie is unauthorized. The strictly earlier in-window control is authorized.

findings.title: An unknown journal controller bypasses all journal invariants

closure_check.method: Run both listed tests
closure_check.expected: The unknown controller and unreserved attempt are refused or become BLOCK.

closure_check.method: Import the original admitted controller with its real reservation
closure_check.expected: The matching journal is accepted and introduces no BLOCK.

findings.title: Journal clone baseline is discarded before reconciliation

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4JournalBaselineMutation
closure_check.expected: A changed baseline is refused or yields an unauthorized finding.

closure_check.method: Test unchanged baseline, absent inventory {}, and a different live root
closure_check.expected: Matching empty baseline passes. Any changed baseline or live root fails.

findings.title: Policy revocation is enforced by the hook but omitted by reconciliation

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4PolicyRevocation
closure_check.expected: The post-change launch is unauthorized, matching the hook's refusal.

closure_check.method: Launch just before, at and after a recorded policy change, then restore the old policy
closure_check.expected: Before-change launch passes; tie and later launches fail. Restoring the policy does not revive the old generation.

findings.title: A later clean scan recommends continuation while a historical BLOCK persists

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditD4LaterCleanScanRecommendation
closure_check.expected: The later clean scan preserves the BLOCK and recommends escalation.

closure_check.method: Run a clean reconciliation with no historic violation
closure_check.expected: The clean control can still recommend continuation.

findings.title: Review validity omits policy revocation and generation bounds

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD4RejectReviewAfterPolicyRevocation, ...RejectOldReviewAfterCorrectionGeneration, ...ReviewWallEnd, ...ReviewPolicyNotPresented
closure_check.expected: Pre-event and forward-progression controls stay authorized; policy, correction-generation and wall-end ties become unauthorized; no presented policy is refused.

closure_check.method: Repeat through the CLI with retained generation plans and reversed event ingestion
closure_check.expected: Same classifications; missing generation or plan evidence refuses authorization.

findings.title: Policy restoration revives a revoked reservation

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD4PolicyRestoreDoesNotReviveHook
closure_check.expected: Replay after restoring the policy is not launch eligible.

closure_check.method: Fresh issuance after policy restoration; separately approved new generation
closure_check.expected: Fresh issuance under the revoked generation is refused; a new approved generation can reserve; hook and reconciliation agree at the revocation tie.

findings.title: Reconciliation accepts the actual implementation worker as reviewer

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD4ReceiptRouteMustMatchReviewAuthority
closure_check.expected: The receipt produces UNAUTHORIZED_DISPATCH as BLOCK without a report import.

closure_check.method: Vary worker, model, provider, effort, packet digest and target separately; check running and completed bound launches
closure_check.expected: Each variation is unauthorized; correctly bound launches stay authorized; an unfinished report grants no credit and does not by itself invalidate a legitimate launch.

findings.title: Reconciliation observes policy drift without persisting revocation

closure_check.method: Run TestR3ReconcilePolicyObservationPersists and TestR3AddendumPolicyObservedRestoreMatrix
closure_check.expected: After a changed-policy reconcile and restore, replay and fresh issuance under the old generation are refused; a post-observation receipt is a BLOCK; before-change and new-generation controls stay eligible.

findings.title: Global policy-pair deduplication loses revocation in later generations

closure_check.method: Run TestR3RepeatedPolicyChangeNewGeneration
closure_check.expected: A repeated change under a later generation is recorded; restoring the policy does not revive that generation; its post-change receipt is a BLOCK.

findings.title: Review issued after a dependency rewind bypasses generation revocation

closure_check.method: Run TestR3ReviewIssuedAfterDependencyRewind and TestR3ReviewAfterDependencyRewindCLI; vary planning, route selection, correction
closure_check.expected: A dependency rewind before packet issuance refuses the packet or makes its launch a BLOCK; before-event, independent-unit, own-forward and fresh-generation controls remain authorized.

findings.title: An unadmitted journal bypasses reconciliation at the transition gate

closure_check.method: Run TestR4IndependentUnadmittedJournalCannotBypassGate with no prior scan and after an earlier clean no-namespace scan (its own namespace-count precondition may no longer hold)
closure_check.expected: Import refuses the journal or the full gate requires reconciliation; no progression append. Explicit scan, admitted matching journal and legacy no-journal controls behave as before.

findings.title: A journal without dispatch attempts skips controller admission binding

closure_check.method: Run TestR4IndependentEmptyJournalMustBindAdmission with zero-attempt matching and mismatched controls
closure_check.expected: Unknown or ambiguous controller is refused or BLOCK; an exactly matching empty journal stays clean.
